cypher.description: One Cypher read, such as MATCH (p:Person {name: $name})-[:KNOWS]->(f) RETURN f LIMIT 25. Neo4j's EXPLAIN must call it read only. No semicolon, USE, LOAD CSV, or CALL of procedures other than db.labels, db.relationshipTypes, db.propertyKeys and db.schema.*.

parameters.description: Values of the statement's $parameters: strings, numbers, booleans, null, lists and maps. Build dates and points in Cypher: date($day), point({x: $x, y: $y}).

limit.description: Most rows to return; the endpoint caps it.
